buys.item: Chai from the stall at the Lodhi Road gate

answer.says: It is the overcast, Sunil. The sun has not yet earned its tyranny today. I am the same weight; only the light is different. Thank you.
answer.thought: The overcast softens the harshness of the morning, allowing the tombs to stand as mere stones rather than symbols of a conquered world. I accept the chai, for the body must be sustained even as the spirit contemplates the stillness of the East. The air is thick, but the mind is clear.
